refactor.title: Refactor & audit
coherence.lead: Pick a sweep, review the live signals, then start it as a single task or as a multi-batch spec.
coherence.preset.state-flow.desc: State transitions, async relays, event sync and race resolution
coherence.preset.state-flow.objective: Audit state transitions, async relays and event sync, and fix the drift where it starts instead of patching call sites.
coherence.preset.contracts.desc: API, schema, mocks, i18n and tests must agree on one contract
coherence.preset.contracts.objective: Restore parity across layers (API, schema, mocks, i18n, tests) so every consumer sees the same contract.
coherence.preset.hotspots.desc: Split modules where changes concentrate; drop duplication and dead code
coherence.preset.hotspots.objective: Split the modules where changes concentrate, remove duplication and dead code, and leave the public contract unchanged.
coherence.preset.docs-specs.desc: README, rule docs, specs and runbooks stay in step with the code
coherence.preset.docs-specs.objective: Sync README, rule docs, specs and runbooks with the code, archive finished specs, and drop stale command lines.
coherence.preset.custom.desc: Point the sweep at any path, module or theme you name
coherence.preset.custom.objective: Run a coherence sweep over the target named above and clean up what it finds.
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.desc: Real defects unit tests miss: boundaries, silent failures, contract gaps, dead ends, ID collisions
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.objective: Hunt the real-world defects that unit tests miss: walk the five blind spots below, reproduce every finding, and change only what the evidence proves.
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.reportOnly: Report only — change no code. Return a severity-ordered defect list where every item carries file:line, the conditions that reproduce it, and a proposed fix.
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.reproduceFirst: Reproduce first — write a failing reproduction test (or a verification command) before touching code, fix only the defects that reproduction confirms, and leave everything you cannot reproduce in the report.
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.check1: External boundaries — CLI / process calls, exit codes, stdout and stderr parsing, timeouts
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.check2: Silent failures — HTTP 200 wrapping an error body, swallowed exceptions, empty results treated as success
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.check3: Sibling-path contract gaps — one route, path or mode updated while its twin is left behind
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.check4: State x action dead ends — an action offered in a state where it cannot finish, or finishes twice
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.check5: ID / cache collisions and operational loops — duplicate ids, stale cache, retry storms, repeated batches
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.orderPolicy: Order the batches by severity: crashes and data loss first, then silent failures, then sibling-path gaps and dead ends, then id / cache collisions. One blind spot per batch.
coherence.preset.bug-hunt.autoFix: Auto-fix the defects a reproduction test confirms (default off = report only)
